contexts.text: The turning aside (or decline) of the Church, Treated of.
They turned aside to him () = abode.
Let down thy pitcher () = the submission of scientifics.
To turn aside = to go to falsity, and then to evil.

(Judah) turned aside to man an Adullamite () = to falsity; for to turn aside = to go off into what is perverted, because to turn aside, like to descend, is predicated of far removal from good to evil, and from truth to falsity.
He turned aside unto her by the way () = that is applied itself (to falsity)... For to turn aside is predicated of falsity.
That they will turn aside from truth in consequence of assaults. Signified, Explained.
To turn aside after many () = conformation, and thus consociation with many.
Thou shalt not turn aside the judgment of thy needy one () = the non-destruction of a little truth... For to turn aside = to pervert, and thus to destroy.
Spirits not upright wanted to avoid this kind of speech.
They begin (in Mars) to decline from a state of integrity.
When they see that they begin to turn aside, they are present.
Turn aside out of the path (). (Explained.)
The third (state of the Church) was its decline. Explained. Coro 29, General article. Coro 54, General article.
